title: THE GANTRY AT THE WEATHERED WORKS
prototype_notice: 15-MINUTE NON-CANON VERTICAL SLICE — identities and location await author approval

arrival.speaker: SITE WORKER [PROTOTYPE]
arrival.line: The upper gantry has started speaking in ways I do not like. We inspect first; we guess only after.

arrival.speaker: KINETIC [PROTOTYPE]
arrival.line: Show us the load path. If it moves, I need to know what will carry me in return.

arrival.speaker: TRANSMUTATIVE [PROTOTYPE]
arrival.line: And I need the material boundary. Repair without continuity is theatre.

objectives.arrival: Meet the worker and enter the site.
objectives.exploration: Cross the approach, inspect the work area, then examine the gantry bracket.
objectives.incident: Use all four roles to stabilise the gantry before the load path fails.
objectives.investigation: Examine exactly three pieces of evidence, then file a report.

interactions.title: PORTABLE SIGNAL SET [PROTOTYPE]
interactions.observation: The instrument has power and its physical relay is intact.
interactions.inference: A missing message cannot yet be blamed on this instrument.

interactions.title: WORK LEDGER [PROTOTYPE]
interactions.observation: The latest visible entry records an inspection, not a completed replacement.
interactions.inference: The page alone does not identify who knew the bracket had worsened.

interactions.title: CORRODED GANTRY BRACKET
interactions.observation: The connection is at 89% before an added Kinetic reaction and 111% after it.
interactions.inference: A push without a sound anchor will cause the connection to fail.

evidence.title: BRACKET FRAGMENT
evidence.observation: Corrosion crosses part of the load-bearing section; the remaining metal shows a fresh fracture.
evidence.inference: The fragment supports progressive weakening, but does not identify responsibility.

evidence.title: CONTROL RECORD
evidence.observation: The recorded load remained within the posted working range before the incident.
evidence.inference: Normal recorded load does not prove the connection was sound.

evidence.title: PROP IMPRINT
evidence.observation: A fresh compression mark aligns beneath the walkway's surviving load path.
evidence.inference: The ordinary worker's prop carried load after the Etherbound commitments ended.

report_choices.label: REPORT OBSERVATIONS; MARK CAUSE UNRESOLVED
report_choices.body: Separate the three observed facts from the still-unverified explanation.

report_choices.label: STATE AN UNVERIFIED CAUSE AS FACT
report_choices.body: File a confident explanation that the available evidence does not establish.

observations_only.heading: THE SITE REMAINS OPEN TO THE TRUTH
observations_only.worker_line: You wrote what the metal can support. The next inspection can still change the answer.
observations_only.detail: The gantry stays isolated, the evidence remains tagged, and no unsupported blame is fixed in the record.

claim_cause.heading: CERTAINTY OUTRAN THE EVIDENCE
claim_cause.worker_line: That may be the answer. It is not yet what we observed.
claim_cause.detail: The same gantry stands, but the report now carries a claim the three clues cannot prove.
